formative_worksheets.title: The Three-Way Measurement Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 minutes) to confirm A10.2 (length, mass, capacity) before extending into non-standard units.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check that probes whether the child can compare across all 3 attributes. Catches children who are strong on length but weak on capacity (or vice versa) before they hit the capstone.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can compare in 3 different ways.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compare in 3 different ways.
header.character_watermark: Max the Measure Moose in the top-right corner with a clipboard. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.visual_layout: Two horizontal pairs stacked: pair A is a short pencil + a long marker; pair B is two same-length blocks. Each pair ~3in × 1in.

image_placeholders.description: Two length-comparison pairs in B&W line art for a Kindergarten formative check. Pair A: a short pencil (~1.5in) + a long marker (~3in), aligned at the left edge. Pair B: two identical-length blocks (~2in each). Each pair ~3in × 1in. Generous spacing for circling.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_LENGTH at Prompt 1: instructions ask the child to circle the longer object. Keywords name the example pair (pencil, marker).

prompts.answer_key: Pair A: marker. Pair B: SAME (accept either or both circled).

prompts.visual_layout: Two balance pictures stacked. Balance 1: brick on left, feather on right (brick lower). Balance 2: two same blocks (level). Each ~3in × 2in.

image_placeholders.description: Two balance pictures in B&W line art for a Kindergarten formative check. Balance 1: brick on left pan (lower) + feather on right pan (higher). Balance 2: two same blocks, level. Each balance ~3in × 2in with triangular fulcrum. Beside each pan, a small label box for writing H, L, or S.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_MASS at Prompt 2: instructions ask the child to mark heavier sides. Keywords name the visual artifact (balance) and the criterion (heavier).

prompts.answer_key: Balance 1: brick = H, feather = L. Balance 2: SAME (both blocks).

prompts.prompt: CAPACITY: Circle the cup that holds more.
prompts.visual_layout: Two cup pairs stacked. Pair A: large mug + tiny espresso cup. Pair B: two same-size cups. Each pair ~3in × 1.5in.

image_placeholders.description: Two cup pairs in B&W line art for a Kindergarten formative check. Pair A: a large mug (~2in) + a tiny espresso cup (~0.7in). Pair B: two identical drinking cups. Each pair ~3in × 1.5in. Generous spacing for circling.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_CAPACITY at Prompt 3: instructions ask the child to circle the cup that holds more. Keywords name the visual element (cup) and criterion (more).

prompts.answer_key: Pair A: large mug. Pair B: SAME (accept either or both circled).

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child; circulate while children work. Score guide: 6/6 (with both 'same' recognized) = ready for non-standard units. 4-5/6 = 1:1 conference about the missed attribute. 0-3/6 = small-group re-loop on Lessons 1-3 before Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Measurement Reflection
reflection_sheet.purpose: End-of-unit metacognition. Children look back at their week of measurement work and rate themselves, name a favourite, name a struggle, and set a forward goal.
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Max and Tess in the top-right corner with a Junior Measure Captain certificate. Small (~1.5in tall combined). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Measure Captain? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Three star-rating options shown horizontally in ovals: 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Below each, a label: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Captain!'. Child circles one.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the end of Lesson 5, alongside the Junior Measure Captain certificate ceremony. Children may need scribe support for prompts 3-5. Read responses to inform next-year unit notes (which prompts kept emerging as 'trickiest', which moments children loved). The yes/no audit on Prompt 2 is also a quick teacher check: a 'NO' on any item signals the child either missed a key activity or doesn't recognize they did it.
